DIFFERENTIATION — TOPIC SYNTHESIS AND PRACTICE
====

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN
----
• Say what differentiation — topic synthesis and practice means in plain words.
• Give one Kenyan example linked to Differentiation.
• Correct one common mistake about this page.

INTRODUCTION
----
Focus on differentiation. On “Differentiation — Topic Synthesis and Practice”, learners often mix up differentiation with a nearby idea. Keep this accurate line instead: Sketch curves using stationary points and intercepts,. Supporting detail: Differentiation in real life.

MAIN NOTES
----
• Differentiation — Topic Synthesis and Practice belongs to number and measurement work in mathematics.
• Always show the method: write what you know → choose an operation or formula → substitute → compute → check.
• Example numbers for this page: 8 and 7 (sum 15, product 56).
• Place value reminder: read each digit’s place carefully in numbers like 444.
• Units matter: write cm, m, Ksh, or items so the answer matches the question.

WORKED EXAMPLE
----
Worked example on Differentiation:
A trader sells 8 items at Ksh 20 each. Find the total.

Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Total = number × amount each
2. Substitute values: Total = 8 × 20
3. Total = 160
Final Answer: Ksh 160
Mark reminder: method mark for multiplication; accuracy mark for answer

Wrong path to avoid: adding 8 + 20 = 28 when equal groups need multiplication.

IN EVERYDAY LIFE
----
Practise Differentiation: focus on differentiation — topic synthesis and practice. Ask which key word or formula fits, then check your answer against the worked example and diagram on this page. Careful checking comes first.

REVISION QUESTIONS
----

2. Show full working (or labeled steps) for a problem on this page about Differentiation.
